title: Battery communication fault
shortDescription: Controller cannot talk to battery BMS.
fullDescription:
Error 10 on Xiaomi Mi scooters means the main controller cannot communicate with the battery BMS. Commonly caused by a deeply discharged battery entering sleep mode or a loose BMS cable under the deck cover.

Try leaving the scooter on the charger for several hours. If still unresponsive, open the battery compartment and check the BMS cable.

fixSteps.title: Inspect BMS cable
fixSteps.instruction: Open deck cover, reseat BMS cable.

faq.a: Often not; deep sleep is recoverable.

title: Battery overvoltage
fullDescription: Error 11 typically appears when charging has used a non-OEM charger or when a battery cell has failed high. Use only an official Xiaomi charger.

title: Battery undervoltage
fullDescription: Error 12 means the battery voltage dropped below BMS protection threshold. Recharge and monitor; cells may have aged.

title: Battery temperature abnormal
shortDescription: Battery temp sensor reports out of range.
fullDescription: Error 13 is raised by the BMS when temperature sensors report abnormal readings — too high, too low, or shorted sensor.

faq.a: No, wait until battery is above 0 C.

title: Battery cell imbalance
shortDescription: Cells are not holding equal charge.
fullDescription: Error 14 signals that individual cells in the pack are drifting apart. Sometimes a complete charge-balance cycle resolves it; more often, cell(s) are weak and the battery is reaching end of life.

fixSteps.title: Balance charge
fixSteps.instruction: Leave on charger 12+ hours after green LED.

title: Battery communication to controller fail
fullDescription: Error 15 indicates data bus failure between battery and controller during operation. Usually a cable issue.

fixSteps.title: Open deck
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect data cable between battery and controller.

faq.a: Yes, moisture in the connector is a common culprit.

title: Motor hall sensor error
fullDescription: Error 21 is raised when the controller cannot read Hall signals from the hub motor. Common after water exposure or a loose cable at the deck.
whenToCallPro: If the hub motor is water-damaged.

faq.a: Yes, but it is a significant job.

title: Motor phase short
fullDescription: Error 26 shows when a phase short is detected. This can be a wiring issue in the deck or a damaged winding in the motor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect phase wires
fixSteps.instruction: Check for damaged insulation at deck entry.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor
fixSteps.instruction: If internal short, install new motor.

faq.a: In severe cases yes; stop using the scooter.

title: Controller/dashboard communication error
fullDescription: Error 30 indicates data loss between dashboard and controller. Usually a stem cable problem.

title: Brake lever fault
shortDescription: Brake lever sensor reports stuck pressed.
fullDescription: Error 35 is the brake lever fault: the system sees the brake permanently engaged. Clean and work the lever, or replace if stuck.

fixSteps.title: Work the lever
fixSteps.instruction: Squeeze and release several times; clean pivot.

whenToCallPro: If internal stem wiring is damaged.

faq.a: Safety — brake and throttle should not both be on.
